formulas.name: Klein Bottle Parametric Equations
formulas.description: Parametric equations for a Klein bottle immersion in 3D space

implementations.python:
def klein_bottle(u, v, r=1.0):
    half_u = u / 2
    cos_u, sin_u = math.cos(u), math.sin(u)
    cos_v, sin_v = math.cos(v), math.sin(v)
    x = r * (cos_u * (1 + sin_u) + sin_v * (1 - cos_u / 2))
    y = r * sin_u + cos_v * (1 - cos_u / 2)
    z = r * math.sin(half_u) * sin_v
    return (x, y, z)
